description: Exercises dedupe_key behavior: identity is (drone_id, source, timestamp) only. Event 2 is a byte-identical resubmission. Event 3 has the SAME identity key but different position/confidence (e.g. a client retry that 'corrected' values) — it must still be rejected as a duplicate, because dedupe is on identity, not payload content.

events._comment: Same identity key (drone_id+source+timestamp) as event 1, but different position/confidence. Must still 409 — dedupe_key does not consider payload.

finalState.note: Only event 1's values ever land in the state — the corrected retry in event 3 is silently rejected at the ingestion boundary, not the resolution layer.
